# getOwnerHQ

> getOwnerHQ is a multi-tenant management platform built for Indian gym owners, fitness studios, MMA clubs, and athletic academies.

## System Overview
- [Home](https://www.getownerhq.in/): Primary landing page and platform features.
- [Sign Up - Free Trial](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/signup): 1-month free trial registration for gym owners.
- [Login](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/login): Secure gym owner dashboard portal.
- [About Us](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/about): Mission and overview of getOwnerHQ.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/terms): Platform terms and conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/privacy): Data privacy policies.
- [Refund Policy](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/refund): Subscription refund terms.

## Comparison Pages
- [Compare All](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/compare): Feature comparison matrix.
- [GymOwl Alternative](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/compare/gymowl-alternative): getOwnerHQ vs GymOwl comparison.
- [getOwnerHQ vs GymMaster](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/compare/getownerhq-vs-gymmaster): getOwnerHQ vs GymMaster comparison.
- [getOwnerHQ vs Wodify](https://www.getownerhq.in/#/compare/getownerhq-vs-wodify): getOwnerHQ vs Wodify comparison.

## Key Capabilities
- Gym Member self-registrations via printable A5 QR Standee
- Real-time expiring membership dashboard & automated status tracking
- 1-tap WhatsApp renewal reminders & custom templates
- Financial ledger, cashfree payment tracking, and revenue analytics
